name: OpenCode
project_binding_recipe: Bind the repo and explicitly expose the items it needs. Connect OpenCode 1.x to the managed wrapper through its local mcp.hasp configuration.
approval_path: Use inline project and secret grants in HASP tools. Start the whole client with hasp agent launch opencode -- opencode for daemon-backed shell protection and operator-issued plaintext grants.
safe_inject_path: Use hasp_run for environment delivery and hasp_inject for temporary credential files; pass named references instead of retrieving plaintext.
write_env_path: Use hasp write-env only after explicit convenience approval for the destination.
